# CopperBuilds

> CopperBuilds builds hand-coded websites and runs local SEO for home services businesses—plumbing, HVAC, electrical, drain & sewer, and water damage restoration, with roofing, garage door, septic, locksmith, and pest control also served. The Starter website build is a flat $1,499 (client owns every file, no lock-in); larger scope is quoted as Custom. Monthly local SEO retainer plans start at $997/mo, month-to-month, no annual contract.

## Pages

- [Home](https://copperbuilds.com/): Overview of web design and local SEO services for home services pros; new sites live within 14 days.
- [Services](https://copperbuilds.com/services): Overview of the two core services—web design and local SEO with Google Business Profile management.
- [Web Design](https://copperbuilds.com/services/web-design): Mobile-first, fast-loading websites for home services pros, live in 14 days.
- [Local SEO](https://copperbuilds.com/services/local-seo): Local SEO and Google Business Profile management to rank in the map pack.
- [Pricing](https://copperbuilds.com/pricing): Flat-rate $1,499 Starter website build (Custom quoted separately) and monthly SEO retainer plans (Local Presence/Lead Machine/Market Leader), with full pricing and inclusions.
- [About](https://copperbuilds.com/about): Who CopperBuilds is and who it serves.
- [How We Work](https://copperbuilds.com/how-we-work): The build and retainer process step by step.
- [Portfolio](https://copperbuilds.com/portfolio): Example website builds for home services clients.
- [Blog](https://copperbuilds.com/blog): SEO and marketing guides for home services businesses (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing).
- [Help Center](https://copperbuilds.com/help): FAQs on website builds, Google Business Profile setup, billing, and post-launch site updates.
- [Contact](https://copperbuilds.com/contact): Get a free quote; requests are answered within 1 hour.
